name: Paranoia
source:
You walk through a world full of danger without seeing it, and it will wear you down.

The twins always make your stomach twist with worry.

[From [url=https://scrawl-24.itch.io/paranoia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你走在一个危机四伏的世界里，自己却看不见那些危险。长此以往，你终会被拖垮。

你总是为那对双胞胎担心得胃都揪紧了。

［摘自[url=https://scrawl-24.itch.io/paranoia]Itch.io[/url]］
